---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability
labels: enhancement
---

**What are you trying to do?**
Describe the workflow, not just the feature — the shape of the solution usually
follows from it.

**Is it already out of scope?**
`openspec/specs/product-vision/spec.md` and `dev-docs/project/active-work.md`
§ Deferred Or Out Of Scope list the deliberate non-goals (multi-window, plugin
marketplace, cloud/collaboration, non-Linux hosts). If your request is there, say why
the trade-off should be revisited rather than that it is missing.

**How does VSCode handle it?**
Not a requirement — but where this project has no opinion, VSCode's behaviour is the
default reference, so a pointer helps.
